evidence: Declarative makerom RSF using public format fields, SVC numbers, service names and module IDs; 134 of 137 mapping keys occur as active settings in the public buildtools template, while act/nfc/qtm occur there as commented module examples with matching IDs. Project choices are title/product ID, ROMFS path, SD flag, memory size, CPU speed, stack and selected service capabilities. Real package validation verifies TitleID, flags and sections.
limits: This attributes the public format and template conventions, not a claim that the entire historical file was independently authored. Public identifiers and configuration settings are retained without claiming original SDK authorship.
